verdict.rationale: The evidence shows structured objects with custom object types and core properties (docs-26, docs-29), collections that export as CSV (docs-31), and a 'Smart queries' feature on the pricing page (docs-27). That suggests property-based querying exists, but the only support is a single pricing-page bullet with no documentation of how it works. Missing for 10: documentation of how smart queries filter by properties, any evidence of live database-style views (tables, boards, lists) rendered from queries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
